Cors._comment: Origins allowed to call this API from a browser. In other environments set them from the environment: Cors__AllowedOrigins__0=https://crm.example.com. A wildcard is refused at start-up — credentialed requests forbid it.

Kyc._comment: DEV ONLY. M02 has its OWN key material, deliberately separate from Customers: a KYC document number and a client's phone must not be decryptable with the same key, and the two modules must rotate independently. Storage:EncryptionKey protects the document images and is separate again. Set all three through user-secrets or the environment elsewhere.

Biometry._comment: UseFake=true runs the whole KYC flow through FakeBiometryClient, with no Flask and no stored token — the dev default. Set it false to reach BaseUrl, which then also needs a per-tenant token: PUT api/v1/kyc-settings/biometry-token. The token is NOT configurable here; it lives in the secrets vault (BiometrySecrets). An empty BaseUrl makes the client answer BIOMETRY_NOT_CONFIGURED without touching the network.

Leads._comment: DEV: auto-dispatch is ON and the threshold lowered to 35 so imported leads reach dispatching (a complete row of docs/sample-lead-import.xlsx scores 30; the ceiling for a file import is 45, since 35 of the 100 points come from activity history that is empty at capture). This applies to EVERY capture channel, not just imports, and to every tenant of this deployment. Historical default is 60 with auto-dispatch off.

Customers._comment: DEV ONLY. In every other environment set these through user-secrets or the environment: dotnet user-secrets set "Customers:FieldEncryptionKey" "$(openssl rand -base64 32)" --project src/Bootstrapper/Sankore.Api

Integration._comment: DEV ONLY. The Integration module has its OWN key material, deliberately separate from Customers and Kyc: a command payload on its way to a core banking system must not be decryptable with the key that opens M01's columns, and the three must rotate independently. Set real ones through user-secrets or the environment elsewhere.

Retry._comment: INT-06: exponential backoff, 8 attempts, one-hour cap. Lowering MaxAttempts does not reject faster — it rejects EARLIER, so a CBS down for a morning loses commands that would have landed.

Swagger._comment: DEV ONLY credentials for /swagger. Development is also the one environment where a missing password lets the documentation through, so a developer who clears these keeps working; everywhere else an unconfigured password answers 503. Set real ones per environment from the environment: Swagger__Auth__Username / Swagger__Auth__Password.

Secrets._comment: DEV ONLY — the secrets vault master key (AES-256, base64, 32 bytes). In every other environment set it through user-secrets or the environment: dotnet user-secrets set "Secrets:EncryptionKey" "$(openssl rand -base64 32)" --project src/Bootstrapper/Sankore.Api. Losing it makes every stored credential undecryptable.
